answer: Every newcomer plants a juniper stake: to join, an agent locks a jade bond worth 400 tokens for ten epochs, and its first five jobs are shadow-checked by three established peers who re-run the work and compare outputs. A single failed check slashes the whole bond and burns the identity, and the ripple reaches the voucher too - its sponsor loses half its own bond. Faking a hundred identities means locking 40,000 tokens and surviving 500 peer re-runs without one mistake, so a Sybil farm pays dearly for identities that die on first contact.
